criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC1:** With the flag enabled and B2 ready, the Hermes sidebar route renders the real supervised dashboard inside the pinned Electron app; starting/failed states are legible, and navigation back to Rhythm works.
criteria.test_id: issue-1542-desktop-c2: real Desktop sidebar and native connection are usable
criteria.reason: Replacement evidence is recorded by docs/ai/contracts/issue-1542-desktop.json criteria issue-1542-desktop-c2 and issue-1542-desktop-c3. Re-run the native Desktop smoke on the final pinned artifact before passing this criterion.

criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC2:** With `RHYTHM_HERMES_ENABLED=0`, no Hermes sidebar entry/view/channel is active; a direct route shows the disabled state and creates zero privileged actions or Hermes launch requests.
criteria.test_id: a disabled direct route explains that Hermes is off and never invokes the native host
criteria.reason: Run apps/web/tests/pages/hermes.spec.ts in an environment where Playwright Chromium may launch.

criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC3:** Runtime probes confirm Node integration off, context isolation/sandbox/web security on, no Rhythm bearer exposure and no access to parent DOM, filesystem/process APIs, arbitrary URLs or broad native IPC; only the Hermes-native auth handoff succeeds.
criteria.test_id: issue-1542-desktop-c1: rejects a sibling Rhythm frame before resolving or creating an embedded host
criteria.reason: Static isolation evidence is recorded by docs/ai/contracts/issue-1542-desktop.json criterion issue-1542-desktop-c1 and apps/electron/test/hermes-view.test.mjs. The real Electron runtime/auth probe must be re-run on the final pinned artifact before passing this criterion.

criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC4:** Valid typed intents navigate to the requested session or open an editable draft with bounded, labelled Rhythm context; neither sends a message nor creates a legacy Rhythm agent session.
criteria.test_id: issue-1542-c4: Hermes forwards a validated new-chat draft without submitting and navigates requested sessions

criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC5:** Foreign/sibling frames, an unapproved origin, malformed or oversize messages, unknown methods and unsupported versions each produce zero native/session actions, zero sends and zero state writes.
criteria.test_id: Hermes protocol rejects unknown versions/types, malformed DTOs and URL injection

criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC6:** A stale document/channel after reload, navigation, route exit or disable produces zero actions; the replacement document can act only through its newly validated channel.
criteria.test_id: Hermes reload revokes old generation; only the current main frame can reactivate

criteria.text: **HRM-B3-AC7:** Rendered route/status/disabled tests pass, keyboard focus enters and exits the embedded view predictably, and 200% zoom/RTL preserve accessible names and controls without nested interactive elements or inaccessible scroll regions.
criteria.test_id: the Desktop host remains keyboard-focusable and accessible at narrow RTL enlarged text
criteria.reason: Prior Desktop rendering is recorded by docs/ai/contracts/issue-1542-desktop.json criterion issue-1542-desktop-c2 and apps/electron/test/hermes-desktop-native.test.mjs. Re-run the rendered web spec plus a real Electron focus-enter/focus-exit probe on the final pin before passing this criterion.
